en.name: Sweet bean sauce
en.summary: Sweet bean sauce is a fermented wheat-flour paste, dark, thick and sweet-salty — the paste behind zhajiangmian and the pancake that comes with Peking duck. Unopened it keeps about 18–24 months in the cupboard. Once opened, refrigerate it and use within about 3–6 months.
en.pantry: Unopened jars and tubs keep on the shelf to the printed date, about 18–24 months from purchase, in a cool dark cupboard. Salt, fermentation and low water activity are what make that possible, so no refrigeration is needed while the seal is intact. Keep the jar upright and away from the hob, and do not store one whose lid has lost its vacuum. These figures are borrowed from hoisin sauce, the closest sweet fermented-soy Chinese sauce with a published number; no agency publishes one for sweet bean sauce itself.
en.fridge: Refrigerate after opening at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use within about 3–6 months. It is sweet as well as salty, so any moisture on the surface will grow mould faster than in a plain salty paste: clean dry spoon, lid on tight, surface smoothed flat every time. Wipe the rim before closing. The paste stiffens in the cold — let the jar stand for a few minutes, or thin a spoonful with a little water or stock in the pan rather than fighting it cold.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for sweet bean sauce and no need for one: salt and sugar already keep it for months in the fridge, longer than most households take to finish a jar. Freezing would separate it and coarsen the smooth texture that makes it good for brushing onto a pancake. Buy the jar size that matches how often you cook with it.
spoilage: Fuzzy mould on the surface or around the rim
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell instead of a deep malty-sweet one
A domed lid or fizzing when the jar is opened
The paste dried into a hard dark crust with liquid separated out
tips: Smooth the surface flat after every use so no crevices hold moisture.
Use a clean dry spoon; sugar plus water is what mould wants.
Wipe the rim before closing so the lid seats cleanly.
Thin a spoonful in the pan rather than watering down the whole jar.

faq.q: Does sweet bean sauce need to be refrigerated after opening?
faq.a: Yes. Refrigerate at 4 °C or below and use within about 3–6 months.

faq.q: How long does an unopened jar keep?
faq.a: About 18–24 months from purchase in a cool dark cupboard. That range is borrowed from hoisin sauce.

faq.q: Can you freeze sweet bean sauce?
faq.a: There is no timeline and no need. It keeps for months refrigerated, and freezing coarsens the texture.

faq.q: Is sweet bean sauce the same as hoisin?
faq.a: They are related but not identical — sweet bean sauce is a wheat-flour paste, hoisin a sweeter, more spiced sauce. They store the same way.

zh.name: 甜麵醬
zh.summary: 甜麵醬是以小麥麵粉發酵而成的醬，深色、濃稠、甜中帶鹹——炸醬麵和烤鴨捲餅靠的就是它。未開封放櫥櫃大約 18～24 個月。開封後請冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的玻璃罐和盒裝放在陰涼避光的櫥櫃，到標示日期為止，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。讓它做得到的是鹽、發酵和低水活性，所以只要封口完好就不需要冷藏。請直立擺放、遠離爐火；蓋子已經沒有真空感的就不要再存放。這些數字借自海鮮醬，那是最接近的中式甜味發酵豆醬且有公布數字；甜麵醬本身沒有機構公布過期限。
zh.fridge: 開封後請放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。它既甜又鹹，所以表面只要有水分，就會比單純的鹹醬更快長霉：每次都用乾淨乾燥的湯匙、蓋子蓋緊、表面抹平。蓋回去前先擦瓶口。低溫下醬會變硬——把罐子放著回溫幾分鐘，或在鍋裡用一點水或高湯把要用的那一匙調開，不要硬挖冷的。
zh.freezer: 甜麵醬沒有冷凍期限，也不需要：鹽和糖已經讓它在冰箱裡放好幾個月，比多數家庭用完一罐的時間還長。冷凍會讓它分離、質地變粗，而那層滑順正是它好刷在餅皮上的原因。請依下廚頻率選罐子大小。
spoilage: 醬面或瓶口周圍長出毛狀的霉
聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味，而不是深沉的麥香甜味
蓋子鼓起，或開罐時冒氣
醬乾成深色硬殼，並分離出液體
tips: 每次取完把表面抹平，不要留下會積水的凹縫。
用乾淨乾燥的湯匙；糖加水正是霉最喜歡的組合。
蓋回去前擦瓶口，蓋子才蓋得乾淨密合。
要調稀就在鍋裡調那一匙，不要把整罐加水。

faq.a: 要。放 4 °C 以下冷藏，並在大約 3～6 個月內用完。

faq.q: 未開封的甜麵醬可以放多久？
faq.a: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃，從購買日起算大約 18～24 個月。這個範圍借自海鮮醬。
沒有對應期限，也沒有必要。它冷藏就能放好幾個月，冷凍反而讓質地變粗。

faq.q: 甜麵醬和海鮮醬一樣嗎？
faq.a: 有關聯但不相同——甜麵醬是小麥麵粉發酵醬，海鮮醬更甜、香料更多。保存方式相同。
